answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded ledge. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the thread of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Net effect on the wharf: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1ab5z.
